title: Role of Biological Age in the Determination of Long-Term Cause-Specific Death Following Percutaneous Coronary Interventions.
summary: A CNN-derived ECG age gap was evaluated in 535 prospective percutaneous-coronary-intervention patients, among whom 124 died over a median 2.61 years; the gap was associated with all-cause and cardiovascular mortality, at a hazard ratio of about 1.07 per year. This is an association only, with no causal or intervention claim.
